name: Wah-wah
description: Wah-wah marks, written and played: the palette's wah tools with an editor for each mark's curve and Q, and a wah pedal (a Cry Baby by default) that the marks rock.

tools.name: Closed Wah-Wah
tools.description: Puts a closed wah-wah mark on the caret's beat or the selected beats, and opens its editor.

tools.name: Open Wah-Wah
tools.description: Puts an open wah-wah mark on the caret's beat or the selected beats, and opens its editor.
